The '''Farboon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tantra sector/Legends|Tantra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farboon]].
